summary_zh: 前文讲孩子在深圳小学语文课需读经典书，作者先在二手书 app 买书，因缺货又换平台，并看到家长群中新书便宜截图。收录帖转向主品牌、当当的新旧书价格对比，称新书约5折、二手约6折。后续作者退二手买新书，并补充二手书店利润处境。上下文显示这是个人购书经历与价格观察，情绪偏理性，传播点在新书低价挤压二手书。

posts.text: My child is in third grade in Shenzhen, China. Their Chinese class requires reading some classic books. I bought a few on a secondhand bookstore app, but the remaining two were out of stock.
posts.original_text: My child is in third grade in Shenzhen, China. Their Chinese class requires reading some classic books. I bought a few on a secondhand bookstore app, but the remaining two were out of stock.
posts.translation_zh: 我的孩子在中国深圳读三年级。他们的语文课要求阅读一些经典书籍。我在一个二手书店 app 上买了几本，但剩下的两本缺货了。
posts.author_bio: I want people to see me, but not know who I am. SocialObserver

posts.text: Then I found them on another secondhand app and placed an order. Later, I saw screenshots from other parents in a group chat; new books were also very cheap.
posts.original_text: Then I found them on another secondhand app and placed an order. Later, I saw screenshots from other parents in a group chat; new books were also very cheap.
posts.translation_zh: 然后我在另一个二手 app 上找到了它们并下了单。后来，我在一个群聊里看到其他家长发的截图；新书也非常便宜。
posts.author_bio: I want people to see me, but not know who I am. SocialObserver

posts.text: I checked on https://t.co/lNdMrPSPjG and https://t.co/yUycYt8kgi, and the prices of new and secondhand books were basically the same. New books were often on sale at 50% off, and secondhand books were usually around 40% off.
posts.original_text: I checked on https://t.co/lNdMrPSPjG and https://t.co/yUycYt8kgi, and the prices of new and secondhand books were basically the same. New books were often on sale at 50% off, and secondhand books were usually around 40% off.
posts.translation_zh: 我在 https://t.co/lNdMrPSPjG 和 https://t.co/yUycYt8kgi 上查了一下，新书和二手书的价格基本一样。新书经常打 5 折促销，二手书通常在 4 折左右。
posts.author_bio: I want people to see me, but not know who I am. SocialObserver

posts.text: So I returned the last two secondhand books and bought new ones. Considering the prices, it's really unnecessary to buy secondhand books. Secondhand bookstores are struggling; they probably only get 10-20% of the original price and sell at 30-40%.

posts.translation_zh: 所以我退了最后两本二手书，买了新的。考虑到价格，真的没必要买二手书。二手书店日子不好过；他们可能只按原价的 10-20% 收书，再按 30-40% 卖出。
